description: Steps per day over a date range, with the daily step goal and walking / running distance (km). Today's row is partial. Defaults to the last 7 days; at most 28 days per call.

end_date.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today, or 6 days after start_date (not past today).

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone. Default: 6 days before end_date. At most 28 days per call.

name: garmin_get_steps
title: Get Garmin steps
